The company name is derived from 'LEg GOdt' (play well).

The company doubled its sales during the first two years of World War II.

creative.headline: How do you sell toys when nobody has money?
creative.subheadline: Economic crisis forcing a pivot to accessible, saleable products.
creative.selectedPain: Selling goods when buyers have no money.
creative.selectedProof: This pivot toward accessible play still anchors the entire brand today.

audio.transcript:
How do you sell toys when nobody has money?
During the global economic crisis, carpenter Ole Kirk Kristiansen needed easy saleable products.
LEGO began with simple wooden toys like cars, airplanes, and yoyos.
This pivot toward accessible play still anchors the entire brand today.
Watch the full story.

scriptBeats.narration: How do you sell toys when nobody has money?
During the global economic crisis, carpenter Ole Kirk Kristiansen needed easy saleable products.
LEGO began with simple wooden toys like cars, airplanes, and yoyos.
This pivot toward accessible play still anchors the entire brand today.

frames.label: Escalation
